title: Migrate API Gateway to Envoy Proxy
description: Replace the legacy AWS API Gateway with a self-managed Envoy Proxy sidecar mesh to cut latency and gain L7 routing control.

sections.heading: Background
sections.body: The current API Gateway introduces ~40 ms of median latency and limits header manipulation. Envoy gives us xDS-based dynamic routing, retries, and circuit breaking without per-request AWS costs.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: Covers the three public-facing services: auth, search, and ingest. Internal gRPC traffic is out of scope for this iteration.

sections.heading: Risk Register
sections.body:
| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| TLS cert rotation gap | Use cert-manager with auto-renew |
| Canary traffic split | Feature-flag per-service |

tasks.text: Profile p50/p99 latency of current API Gateway
Document all active routes and auth integrations
Evaluate Envoy control-plane options (Istio vs raw xDS)
Author Envoy bootstrap config and Docker image
Deploy to staging behind feature flag
Wire xDS control plane for dynamic route updates
Run load test and compare latency profiles
Canary 10 % of auth traffic through Envoy
Ramp to 100 % and monitor error budget
Disable API Gateway endpoints and update DNS
Archive access logs and cost reports
